summary: Make The Bayes Group site a prerendered static website. Vite + React + TypeScript + react-router stay. `npm run build` runs `vite build`, then an SSR build of a new src/entry-server.tsx, then scripts/prerender.mjs. The prerender step writes dist/index.html, dist/services/index.html, dist/training/index.html, dist/about/index.html, dist/contact/index.html and dist/404.html. Each file has the page's full markup in #root and its own head tags: title, one-sentence description, Open Graph tags, canonical link and favicon link. All page metadata lives in src/seo.ts. main.tsx hydrates the prerendered markup with hydrateRoot. Also add public/favicon.svg, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. Fix the review notes: How-we-work CSS, footer contents, pillar title class, scroll and focus on route change, and a consistent contact field style with consistent "Required" tags. Rewrite DEPLOYMENT.md for a static host with no SPA rewrite.
steps: Keep every existing export and behavior. src/App.tsx keeps exporting `AppRoutes`: the Routes with Layout and all pages, no Router inside it. All existing acceptance tests must keep passing. They render `<MemoryRouter initialEntries={[path]}><AppRoutes/></MemoryRouter>` and expect the same titles, h1s, landmarks, header, footer, menu, training filter and contact form behavior.

Create src/seo.ts with these named exports:
- `SITE_URL = 'https://thebayesgroup.com'` and `SITE_NAME = 'The Bayes Group'`.
- `PAGES`: an array in this order of `{ path, title, description }`:
  - '/': 'The Bayes Group | Evidence-driven AI'
  - '/services': 'Services | The Bayes Group'
  - '/training': 'Training | The Bayes Group'
  - '/about': 'About | The Bayes Group'
  - '/contact': 'Contact | The Bayes Group'
- `NOT_FOUND_PAGE`: `{ path: '/404', title: 'Page not found | The Bayes Group', description }`.
- `getPageMeta(path: string)`: returns the PAGES entry whose path equals `path` after stripping any query, hash and trailing slash ('/' stays '/'). Otherwise it returns NOT_FOUND_PAGE.

Every description is exactly one sentence. It ends with a period, contains no other sentence-ending '. ', '! ' or '? ', and is unique per page. useDocumentTitle (or each page) takes its titles from these same entries, so document.title stays exactly as today.

Create src/entry-server.tsx. Do not use import.meta or CSS imports in it, because Jest imports it. It has two named exports: - `render(url: string): string` returns `renderToString()`. StaticRouter comes from 'react-router-dom/server' on v6 (or 'react-router' on v7). - `buildPageHtml(template: string, url: string): string` takes the app's index.html (source or built) and returns the full page: 1. Remove any existing ``, `<meta name="description">`, og:* meta, canonical link and `<link rel="icon">` from the template. 2. Insert before `</head>`, from getPageMeta(url): `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `<meta property="og:title">` (= title), `<meta property="og:description">` (= description), `<meta property="og:type" content="website">`, `<meta property="og:site_name" content="The Bayes Group">`, `<link rel="canonical" href=SITE_URL + path>` and `<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg">`. The canonical href is 'https://thebayesgroup.com/' for home and e.g. 'https://thebayesgroup.com/services', with no trailing slash, for the others. HTML-escape all attribute values. 3. Put render(url) inside `<div id="root"></div>`. 4. Keep everything else, including the module script tags. Because the result has exactly one title, description and icon link, it does not matter whether index.html itself contains a favicon link.

Create scripts/prerender.mjs:
1. Import `buildPageHtml` from the SSR bundle (dist-server/entry-server.js).
2. Read dist/index.html once as the template, before overwriting it.
3. Write dist/index.html ('/'), dist/services/index.html, dist/training/index.html, dist/about/index.html and dist/contact/index.html.
4. Write dist/404.html from buildPageHtml(template, '/404'), which renders the NotFound page.
5. Remove dist-server afterwards (also list it in .gitignore).

In package.json, set `"build": "tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs"`. Drop the `tsc --noEmit` part if the current build doesn't use tsc. Add no preinstall, postinstall or prepare scripts and no new framework. Keep current dependency versions.

src/main.tsx imports the CSS and builds `<React.StrictMode><BrowserRouter><AppRoutes/></BrowserRouter></React.StrictMode>`. If #root has child elements, it calls `hydrateRoot(root, app)`; otherwise (vite dev) it uses `createRoot(root).render(app)`. The server tree and the client tree must produce identical markup, so hydration logs no mismatch errors. Do not read window, document or localStorage during render; only read them in effects.

Create src/components/ScrollManager.tsx, used in Layout. It skips the first render (a ref flag) and then reacts to each `useLocation()` change of pathname or hash:
- With a hash: `document.getElementById(hash.slice(1))?.scrollIntoView()`. Use the plain call; the offset comes from CSS `scroll-margin-top`.
- Without a hash: `window.scrollTo(0, 0)`, then `document.getElementById('main')?.focus({ preventScroll: true })`. `<main id="main" tabIndex={-1}>` already exists.

On the first load nothing scrolls and focus is not moved. In global.css, give `[id]` targets / the service sections `scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--header-h) + 24px)` (at least 96px).

Home 'How we work': give every class used inside that section a rule in src/styles/global.css. Every class name in the section's elements must appear as a selector there.
- Phones: steps stack.
- Inside `@media (min-width: 1024px)`: the step list uses `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr)` with a thin horizontal line, a `::before` pseudo-element on a section class using `--color-border`/`--color-accent`, behind the 40px numbered circles (`position: relative; z-index` on the circles).

Pillar cards: the class on the pillar h3 gets its own rule: `font-family: var(--font-serif)`, navy, and margins between icon, title and text, matching the course and service card titles. Every class used inside a pillar card must have a CSS rule.

Footer (src/components/Footer.tsx) shows only:
- the Wordmark (in a home link),
- the line 'AI enablement, training and custom development.' (exactly once),
- `<nav aria-label="Footer">` with the links Services, Training, About, Contact,
- '© 2026 The Bayes Group'.

Remove the extra tagline paragraph. There is no other text outside links and the nav.

Contact form (src/pages/ContactPage.tsx and global.css): - Every control (inputs, the select and the textarea) has the class `form-control`. - The `.form-control` rule uses `border: 1.5px solid var(--color-input-border)`. - `.form-control:focus` (or `:focus-visible`) uses `border-color: var(--color-accent-strong)` or `var(--color-accent)` plus the focus ring. - `.form-control[aria-invalid="true"]` uses `border-color: var(--color-error)`. - No other rule colors field borders red. - Only fields with an error get `aria-invalid="true"`. Company and topic never get it; on an empty submit, name, email and message do. - Each required field (Name, Email, Message; exactly the controls with the `required` attribute) has one 'Required' tag. All three tags are the same element type with the same className (e.g. `Required`), placed the same way, outside the `

Create the public files:
- public/favicon.svg: a standalone SVG with xmlns and a viewBox, containing the wordmark's bell-curve path with stroke `#1F8A8A`.
- public/robots.txt: 'User-agent: *', 'Allow: /' and 'Sitemap: https://thebayesgroup.com/sitemap.xml'.
- public/sitemap.xml: a valid urlset (sitemaps.org namespace) with exactly five `<loc>` entries: https://thebayesgroup.com/, https://thebayesgroup.com/services, https://thebayesgroup.com/training, https://thebayesgroup.com/about and https://thebayesgroup.com/contact.

Rewrite DEPLOYMENT.md for a static host:
- `npm run build` prerenders one HTML file per page.
- Upload dist/ as it is; no SPA fallback or rewrite rule is needed, because every page is its own file.
- Unknown addresses get 404.html (configure it on hosts that need it, e.g. nginx `error_page 404 /404.html` with `try_files $uri $uri/ =404`).
- Remove the `/* /index.html 200` _redirects rule, the `try_files ... /index.html` fallback and the 'unknown route returns index.html with 200' check.
- Keep the security headers guidance.
- Mention robots.txt, sitemap.xml and favicon.svg.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Runs the app's acceptance tests: the Jest files in __tests__/acceptance/. Generated by the pipeline; the tests
themselves are locked files written by the planner. ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE=N runs only the tests of milestones 1..N."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.chdir(here)
if not os.path.isdir("node_modules"):
    lock = os.path.exists("package-lock.json")
    subprocess.run(["npm", "ci" if lock else "install", "--include=dev", "--no-audit", "--no-fund"], check=False, timeout=1500)
cmd = ["npx", "jest", "--ci", "__tests__/acceptance"]
m = os.environ.get("ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE", "")
if m.isdigit():
    cmd += ["-t", "^(" + "|".join("M%d" % i for i in range(1, int(m) + 1)) + "): "]
# The app's own test script may add node flags (e.g. --experimental-vm-modules): use the same ones.
try:
    script = json.load(open("package.json")).get("scripts", {}).get("test", "")
except (OSError, ValueError):
    script = ""
env = dict(os.environ)
if "--experimental-vm-modules" in script:
    env["NODE_OPTIONS"] = (env.get("NODE_OPTIONS", "") + " --experimental-vm-modules").strip()
print("Running: " + " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
sys.exit(subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, timeout=1500).returncode)
